Export analysis results to CSV files

Source: R/Export.R
exportToCsv.Rd

Reads `summary.csv` and per-analysis `.rds` files produced by [runPnuAnalyses()] and writes three flat CSV files to `exportFolder` whose column names match the results data model specification:

* `analysis.csv` — one row per analysis. * `estimate.csv` — point estimate and CI per analysis; calibrated columns are included when present in `summary.csv` (i.e. after [calibrateEstimates()] has been applied), otherwise filled with `NA`. * `covariate_balance.csv` — covariate balance rows; omitted when no analysis produced balance data.

Every file receives a leading `database_id` column so that exports from multiple databases can be stacked for use with Strategus or a Shiny results viewer.

Usage

exportToCsv(outputFolder, exportFolder, databaseId, minCellCount = 5L)

Arguments

outputFolder

Path to the folder produced by [runPnuAnalyses()]. Must contain `summary.csv`.

exportFolder

Path to the folder where CSV files are written. Created if it does not exist.

databaseId

Character string identifying the source database. Written as the first column of every exported file.

minCellCount

Minimum allowable cell count; reserved for future small-cell suppression. Default: `5L`.

Value

`NULL` invisibly.

Details

`minCellCount` is accepted for forward compatibility; the current data model stores log-scale estimates and proportions rather than raw counts, so no rows are suppressed at present.

See also

[runPnuAnalyses()], [calibrateEstimates()], [uploadResults()]

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
runPnuAnalyses(
  connectionDetails = connectionDetails,
  cdmDatabaseSchema = "cdm",
  cohortDatabaseSchema = "cohorts",
  cohortTable = "cohort",
  covariateSettings = covariateSettings,
  pnuAnalysisList = analysisList,
  outputFolder = "output"
)
exportToCsv(
  outputFolder = "output",
  exportFolder = "export",
  databaseId   = "Synpuf"
)
} # }
